description: Na₂RuN₅H₅O₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and six O atoms. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.56 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.79 Å. Ru is bonded in an octahedral geometry to five N and one O atom. There are a spread of Ru-N bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.14 Å. The Ru-O bond length is 1.99 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ru and one O atom. The N-O bond length is 1.16 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ru and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.21 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) N-O bond length. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ru and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) N-O bond length. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.75 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na and one H atom. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.35 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one N and one O atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ru, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom.
